The multiphase formulation further enables distinct kinetic relations and interfacial energies to be assigned to different order-parameter pairs, which reflects the distinguishable properties of the different types of ferroelectric domain walls. The proposed framework is broadly applicable for simulating kinetic relations in materials with applications beyond ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种机电耦合多相场框架，可嵌入任意动力学关系，用于模拟铁电体等材料中界面运动，突破了传统Allen-Cahn线性动力学的限制。
AI.motivation: 经典相场模型采用Allen-Cahn演化律，隐含界面速度与驱动力之间为线性动力学关系。但铁电陶瓷等材料常表现出非线性动力学关系，因此需要替代的演化律与模型。
AI.method: 提出一种应力驱动的机电耦合多相场框架，采用通用动力学表述，将预先给定的动力学关系直接积分进演化律。多相表述允许对不同序参量对赋予不同的动力学关系和界面能。
AI.result: 该模型能够按指定的非线性动力学正确演化畴壁，例如符合Merz-Stadler律的混合指数-幂律型动力学；并能区分不同类型铁电畴壁的性质。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架广泛适用于模拟材料中的动力学关系，应用范围不限于铁电体。

title: Enabling Domain-Specific Atomistic Models: A Machine Learning Potential for the Solid Acid Family
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials trained across the periodic table have made atomistic simulation broadly accessible, and specializing them to a single compound class is widely expected to improve accuracy. Yet examples remain scarce, and fewer still surpass universal models in speed or reach a higher level of electronic-structure theory. Here we present a potential that is universal within the class of water-free solid-state hydrogen-bond network mediated proton conductors rather than across chemistry and a database of 4.4 million first-principles configurations spanning 55 materials. It surpasses leading general-purpose potentials across this domain, recovering measured activation energies and the ordering of anion rotational dynamics that those models miss; agreement on static structure does not imply agreement on transport. Accuracy falls for compositions far from the training set but stays competitive for close structural relatives, and a higher level of electronic-structure theory is reached with a few hundred additional configurations per material. We further introduce a compact variant carrying a fifth of the parameters, faster still and yet more accurate than every general-purpose model tested. It sustains more than a quarter of a million atoms on a single graphics processor, placing grain boundaries and the transition into the highly conducting phase within reach, and making a quantum treatment of the protons affordable. Reference accuracy and accessible system size thus become largely independent, offering a template for other compound classes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个针对无水质子导体这一特定化合物类别（而非全元素通用）的机器学习原子间势，基于55种材料、440万第一性原理构型数据库训练，精度超越通用模型并能达到更高电子结构理论层次。
AI.motivation: 通用机器学习势虽使原子模拟普及，但将其特化到单一化合物类别通常被认为能提升精度，然而此类特化成功案例稀缺，且很少能在速度上超越通用模型或达到更高电子结构理论层次。
AI.method: 构建覆盖55种材料、440万第一性原理构型的数据库，训练一个在无水固态氢键网络介导质子导体类别内"通用"的机器学习势；并进一步开发参数量仅五分之一的紧凑变体。
AI.result: 该势超越领先通用模型，重现了活化能和阴离子旋转动力学排序；仅在远离训练分布时精度下降。紧凑变体更快更准，可在单GPU上模拟超25万原子，涵盖晶界和高导相转变，并使质子量子处理变得可行。
AI.conclusion: 参考精度与可及体系规模得以基本解耦，为其他化合物类别提供了可推广的范式。

title: Anisotropic wavevector-dependent damping of thickness-quantized magnons
summary: Magnon damping is a key factor governing spin-wave transport and nonlinear dynamics of multimode magnon systems. However, many descriptions rely on the assumption of an effective mode-independent parameter, which can mask wavelength-dependent relaxation processes that depend on propagation geometry and mode profile. Here, we employ high-resolution parametric-instability spectroscopy to probe thickness-quantized spin waves with wavelengths down to about a hundred nanometers in micrometer-thick yttrium iron garnet films. The instability threshold exhibits a regular sawtooth dependence on the magnetic field, arising from switching between discrete thickness modes. Comparison with dipole--exchange theory reveals anisotropic wavevector-dependent damping that increases with mode number and depends differently on the in-plane and out-of-plane wavevector components.

AI.tldr: 利用高分辨参量不稳定性谱测量微米厚YIG薄膜中纳米波长的厚度量化自旋波，发现阻尼强烈依赖于波矢和模式。
AI.motivation: 以往对磁振子阻尼的描述多假设模式无关的有效参数，掩盖了依赖于传播几何和模式结构的波长相关弛豫过程。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率参量不稳定性谱技术，探测微米厚钇铁石榴石薄膜中波长低至约百纳米的厚度量化自旋波。
AI.result: 不稳定性阈值随磁场呈规则锯齿状依赖，源于离散厚度模式间的切换；与偶极-交换理论对比揭示出各向异性的波矢相关阻尼，其随模式数增加，且对平面内和平面外波矢分量依赖不同。
AI.conclusion: 磁振子阻尼不能用单一模式无关参数描述，而是具有显著的波矢各向异性与模式依赖性，对自旋波传输与非线性动力学建模具有重要意义。

title: Varying A-site radius and size disorder to tune magnetic ordering in compositionally complex perovskite oxides
summary: A long standing goal of magnetochemists is to be able to control ordering temperatures through compositional engineering. Here we report the synthesis of a perovskite oxide with twelve cations accommodated within a single phase solid solution, AM7O$_3$, A = La$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Sm$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Gd$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Nd$_{\frac{1}{5}}$Dy$_{\frac{1}{5}}$ (A5), and M7 = Ti$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Cr$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Mn$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Fe$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Co$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Ni$_{\frac{1}{7}}$Cu$_{\frac{1}{7}}$. Bulk magnetometry measurements for A5M7O$_3$, as well as for A = La, Gd and La$_{\frac{1}{2}}$Gd$_{\frac{1}{2}}$, show that all these compounds magnetically order as ferrimagnets between 89 and 115 K. We find that the magnetic properties are influenced by considering a combination of the size disorder parameter alongside the A-site cationic radii and valence electrons.

AI.tldr: 本文合成了一种含十二种阳离子的钙钛矿氧化物固溶体A5M7O3，发现其及对照化合物均为亚铁磁体，居里温度在89–115 K之间。
AI.motivation: 磁化学家长久以来的目标是通过成分工程调控材料的磁有序温度。
AI.method: 合成单相固溶体钙钛矿氧化物AM7O3，其中A位为五种稀土离子（La、Sm、Gd、Nd、Dy各1/5），M位为七种过渡金属离子（Ti、Cr、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu各1/7）；对A5M7O3及A=La、Gd、La1/2Gd1/2的对照样品进行体磁测量。
AI.result: 所有化合物均在89–115 K之间表现为亚铁磁有序；磁性与尺寸无序参数、A位阳离子半径和价电子数的组合相关。
AI.conclusion: 通过多阳离子成分设计可调控钙钛矿氧化物的磁有序温度，且尺寸无序、A位半径与价电子数共同决定磁性。

title: Spectral theory for dynamical large deviations in non-Markov self-interacting processes
summary: We develop a spectral theory for dynamical large deviations in non-Markov jump processes and non-Markov chains, whose dynamics depends on the past through state- and jump-dependent empirical observables. We demonstrate that a multiscale Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin-Jeffreys (WKBJ) Ansatz separates fast configurational relaxation from slow memory evolution, reducing the Feynman--Kac equation for occupation and flux statistics to an eigenvalue problem for a new tilted operator coupled to Hamilton--Jacobi characteristics. This provides a computationally efficient framework for quantifying fluctuations in a broad class of non-Markovian systems. We illustrate our general results with a bistable self-induced East model.

AI.tldr: 本文为非马尔可夫跳跃过程与非马尔可夫链建立了动力学大偏差的谱理论，通过多尺度WKBJ假设将Feynman-Kac方程约化为倾斜算子的本征值问题，实现高效涨落量化。
AI.motivation: 非马尔可夫系统中动力学大偏差的理论刻画困难，其动力学依赖历史（通过状态与跳跃相关的经验可观测量），缺乏高效计算框架。
AI.method: 采用多尺度Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin-Jeffreys (WKBJ)假设，将快构型弛豫与慢记忆演化分离；把占据数与流统计的Feynman-Kac方程约化为新倾斜算子的本征值问题，并与Hamilton-Jacobi特征耦合。
AI.result: 为一大类非马尔可夫系统提供了计算高效的涨落量化框架，并以双稳态自诱导East模型作为示例验证。
AI.conclusion: 该谱理论可推广至广泛的非马尔可夫动力系统，为量化其罕见涨落提供了有效工具。

title: Smart Machine Learning for Solving the Full Electron-Nuclear Schrödinger Equation with a Quantum-Chemically Inspired Wavefunction Ansatz
summary: Directly solving the full electron-nuclear Schrödinger equation remains one of the grand challenges in quantum mechanics. Here, we propose a quantum-chemically motivated orbital-based neural network wavefunction ansatz with explicit many-body electron-electron correlation terms, with parameters depending on the entire electron-nuclear configuration, enabling an accurate description of strongly correlated and/or multi-reference electronic structures by a single Slater-determinant across a broad nuclear configuration space. To train this wavefunction, we further develop an efficient hybrid optimization strategy that combines the variational Monte Carlo technique with local-energy constraints, mitigating the intrinsic sampling bias of the former and considerably reducing the statistical error. These advances are embedded in a unified neural network framework, Schrödinger, enabling the determination of globally accurate potential energy surfaces with a single training for systems ranging from strongly correlated diatomic molecules, triatomic reactions containing conical intersections, to polyatomic multi-reference molecules. This work offers a practical machine-learning tool for solving the electron-nuclear Schrödinger equation and capturing full quantum effects beyond the Born-Oppenheimer approximation.

AI.tldr: 提出轨道基神经网络波函数拟设Schrödinger，含显式多体电子相关项，结合VMC与局域能量约束的混合优化，单次训练即可获得全局精确势能面。
AI.motivation: 直接求解完整的电子-核薛定谔方程仍是量子力学重大挑战；需准确描述强关联与多参考电子结构，并捕捉超越Born-Oppenheimer近似效应。
AI.method: 量子化学启发的轨道基神经网络波函数拟设，参数依赖整个电子-核构型，含显式多体电子-电子相关项，用单个Slater行列式描述多参考态；采用变分蒙特卡洛与局域能量约束结合的混合优化策略。
AI.result: 缓解采样偏差、显著降低统计误差；单次训练即可对强关联双原子分子、含锥形交叉的三原子反应及多原子多参考分子获得全局精确势能面。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一个实用的机器学习工具，可求解电子-核薛定谔方程并捕捉超越Born-Oppenheimer近似之外的全量子效应。

title: Dense and porous phase transition study of SEI formation using phase-field method
comment: It has 7 figures and 1 supplementary paper
summary: The solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) is essential for the long-term stability of batteries because it influences the reactions between the electrode and electrolyte. Despite previous studies, the SEI evolution from dense to porous phases remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigate the SoC-dependent evolution of the SEI using a phase-field framework under open-circuit conditions. Spatially correlated noise is introduced to describe stochastic transport perturbations, and the dense-to-porous transition time is evaluated from the evolution of interface roughness arising from the competition between noise-induced transport and surface relaxation. The simulations reveal three distinct roughness evolution regimes. The predicted transition time generally increases from approximately one month at 20% SoC to more than seven months at 80% SoC, with a pronounced change between 55% and 60%. This change corresponds to the graphite SoC-OCV relation, which controls the interfacial Li0 radical concentration through the Nernst condition. Under dynamic SoC conditions caused by irreversible capacity loss, the transition behavior changes as the SoC evolves during storage. These results show that the SoC-OCV relation is central to determining SEI phase stability and the dense-to-porous transition time under open-circuit storage.

AI.tldr: 利用相场框架研究开路条件下SEI随SoC演变，从致密到多孔相变时间随SoC增大而延长，受石墨SoC-OCV关系控制。
AI.motivation: SEI对电池长期稳定性至关重要，但其从致密相向多孔相的演变机制尚不完全清楚，需明确SoC对SEI相稳定性和转变时间的影响。
AI.method: 在开路条件下采用相场框架，引入空间相关噪声描述随机输运扰动，通过界面粗糙度演化（噪声诱导输运与表面弛豫竞争）评估致密-多孔转变时间，并结合Nernst条件分析界面Li0自由基浓度。
AI.result: 模拟揭示三种粗糙度演化机制；预测转变时间从20% SoC的约1个月增至80% SoC的超过7个月，在55%–60% SoC间变化显著，对应石墨SoC-OCV关系；动态SoC（不可逆容量损失）下转变行为随储存中SoC演化而改变。
AI.conclusion: SoC-OCV关系是决定开路储存下SEI相稳定性和致密-多孔转变时间的核心因素。

title: Magnetization relaxation of interacting chains of nanomagnets
summary: We investigate the magnetization dynamics crossover from single-particle to collective behavior in a one-dimensional chain of dipolar-coupled nanomagnets with uniaxial anisotropy. Using both an intermediate-to-high damping (IHD) analytical approach based on Langer's theory and time-quantified Monte Carlo (TQMC) simulations, we derive and validate semi-analytical expressions for the relaxation rate and the magnetization relaxation curves. Our main results include: (i) a closed-form expression for the relaxation rate accounting for (weak) dipolar interactions, (ii) a two-exponential semi-analytical formula for the magnetization dynamics $m(t)$ of an interacting chain, and (iii) a systematic comparison with TQMC simulations, showing good agreement for a wide range of parameters. The analysis reveals a field-controlled crossover from uniform (macrospin-like) reversal to edge-nucleation propagation, driven by the spatial inhomogeneity of dipolar stabilization. The derived expressions provide a computationally efficient framework for predicting the relaxation behavior of dipolar-coupled nanomagnetic assemblies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维偶极耦合纳米磁体链中从单粒子到集体磁化动力学的过渡，结合Langer理论的IHD解析方法和TQMC模拟，推导并验证了弛豫速率和磁化弛豫曲线的半解析表达式，揭示了场控的从均匀翻转（类宏自旋）到边缘成核传播的交叉行为。
AI.motivation: 理解偶极耦合纳米磁体链中单粒子与集体磁化行为的过渡机制，并提供一个计算高效的框架来预测其弛豫行为，避免昂贵的全数值模拟。
AI.method: 采用基于Langer理论的中间至高阻尼（IHD）解析方法，结合时间量化的蒙特卡洛（TQMC）模拟，推导考虑弱偶极相互作用的弛豫速率闭式表达式及双指数半解析磁化动力学公式，并进行系统的参数对比验证。
AI.result: (i) 得到考虑弱偶极相互作用的弛豫速率闭式表达式；(ii) 得到交互链磁化动力学m(t)的双指数半解析公式；(iii) 与TQMC模拟在广泛参数范围内吻合良好；揭示了由偶极稳定化的空间不均匀性驱动的场控交叉——从均匀（类宏自旋）翻转到边缘成核传播。
AI.conclusion: 所推导的表达式为偶极耦合纳米磁体组件的弛豫行为预测提供了计算高效的框架，并阐明了场控下单粒子到集体行为过渡的物理机制。

title: Chiral quantum chaos around exponentially many zero modes in the quantum breakdown model
summary: The quantum breakdown model is a model of randomly interacting fermions, motivated by the physics of dielectric breakdown. Here, we establish classification of symmetry and quantum chaos in a zero-dimensional, all-to-all-interacting version of the quantum breakdown model. It exhibits the $\mathbb{Z}_4$ periodicity with respect to the number of fermionic modes, reminiscent of the symmetry classification of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model. A unique feature of the quantum breakdown model is that it realizes all the five classes with chiral symmetry and hosts an exponentially large number of many-body zero modes protected by the chiral index. We elucidate the separation and scaling of the spectral gap and demonstrate the symmetry-enriched hard-edge spectral statistics as signatures of quantum chaos in the chiral symmetry classes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了零维全连接量子击穿模型的对称性与量子混沌分类，揭示了其Z4周期性及手征对称性导致的指数级多体零模。
AI.motivation: 量子击穿模型源于介电击穿物理，描述随机相互作用的费米子。作者希望在零维全连接版本中对对称性和量子混沌进行分类，类比Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型的对称性分类。
AI.method: 针对零维全连接的量子击穿模型，进行对称性分类与谱分析，考察费米子模式数的Z4周期性、手征对称类、多体零模数量、谱隙及能谱统计。
AI.result: 该模型展现出关于费米子模式数的Z4周期性；能实现包含手征对称性的全部五类；具有指数级数量的、由手征指数保护的多体零模；阐明了谱隙的分离与标度行为，并展示了手征对称类中对称性增强的硬边缘谱统计作为量子混沌特征。
AI.conclusion: 零维全连接量子击穿模型提供了研究手征对称类量子混沌的独特平台，其零模与谱统计特征为量子混沌在手征对称类中的表现提供了signature。

title: Polymorph-Tunable Spin Texture and Excitonic Structures in Monolayer WSi2P4
summary: Two-dimensional semiconductors that simultaneously possess a direct band gap and strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) are highly attractive for quantum optoelectronics. Using first-principles GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) calculations, we show that monolayer WSi2P4-an experimentally accessible member of the MSi2X4 family-hosts a direct K-valley gap together with strong SOC. Its three competing polymorphs (alpha, beta and gamma) are all direct-gap semiconductors and are kinetically locked behind 1.3 eV migration barriers. The sigma_h mirror plane of the D3h of alpha and gamma phases enforces a persistent spin texture across the Brillouin zone, weakly modulated near gamma by interband SOC mixing, whereas the polar beta phase (C3v) exhibits Rashba spin splitting. SOC splits the doubly-degenerate lowest bright exciton into dark states and splits the original absorption peak into two peaks (A and B), whose relative brightness is governed by the K-valley conduction-band splitting. alpha-WSi2P4 displays the brightest Peak A because a tiny band crossing of opposite-spin branches can open a spin-allowed radiative channel. These results establish the MSi2P4 family as a phase-tunable platform for the cooperative engineering of spin texture, band splitting, and excitonic brightness within a single material system.

AI.tldr: 单层WSi2P4三种同质异形体均为直接带隙半导体并具强自旋轨道耦合，可实现自旋织构、能带劈裂与激子亮度的相调控。
AI.motivation: 寻找同时具备直接带隙与强自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的二维半导体，用于量子光电子学。
AI.method: 第一性原理GW加Bethe-Salpeter方程（GW-BSE）计算。
AI.result: WSi2P4的α、β、γ相均为直接带隙，动力学上被1.3 eV迁移势垒锁定；α和γ相（D3h）因σh镜面产生持久自旋织构，β相（C3v）出现Rashba劈裂；SOC将最低亮激子劈裂为暗态，吸收峰分为A、B两峰，相对亮度由K谷导带劈裂决定；α-WSi2P4的A峰最亮，源于相反自旋分支的微小能带交叉开启自旋允许辐射通道。
AI.conclusion: MSi2P4家族是可在单一材料体系中协同调控自旋织构、能带劈裂与激子亮度的相可调平台。

title: Multi-Branch Transport in a Back-gated WS$_2$ Transistor at Deep-Cryogenic Temperature
summary: Two-dimensional materials are promising candidates for electronic applications beyond the operating limits of conventional semiconductor technologies. Within this class, transition-metal dichalcogenides offer attractive properties for field-effect transistor operation, with tungsten disulphide (WS$_2$) emerging as a particularly promising material for operation at cryogenic temperatures. Here, we investigate the electrical performance of a back-gated multilayer WS$_2$ transistor at deep cryogenic temperature, down to 20 mK. The device remains strongly gate-tunable throughout the cryogenic regime, with an effective on/off current ratio exceeding $10^{5}$. Most notably, the low-temperature turn-on characteristics exhibit reproducible shoulder-like features, which we describe using a phenomenological model comprising multiple effective conduction branches operating in parallel.

AI.tldr: 研究了多层WS₂背栅晶体管在深低温(低至20 mK)下的电学性能，器件保持强栅可调性，开关比超10⁵，并观察到可复现的肩状开启特征。
AI.motivation: 二维材料有望突破传统半导体技术的电子应用极限，其中过渡金属硫族化物(如WS₂)在低温场效应晶体管中很有前景，因此需探究其在深低温下的电学行为。
AI.method: 制备背栅多层WS₂晶体管，在低至20 mK的深低温下测量其电学性能，并用多个有效导电支路并联的唯象模型分析开启特性。
AI.result: 器件在整个低温区保持强栅可调，有效开关电流比超过10⁵；低温开启特性呈现可复现的肩状特征，可由多导电支路并联的唯象模型描述。
AI.conclusion: 多层WS₂晶体管在深低温下具有良好的栅控能力和高开关比，其肩状开启特征可通过多有效导电支路并联机制解释，显示WS₂在低温电子学中的应用潜力。

title: Qantum Well Resonant Tunneling Diode Probe of Correlated States in Twisted Bilayer MoS$_2$
summary: Moiré superlattices formed in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) offer a versatile platform for exploring emergent quantum phases arising from strong electronic correlations. In this work, we develop a new experimental platform, the quantum well resonant tunneling diode (QWRTD), to probe the electronic landscape of $\approx 57^\circ$ twisted bilayer MoS$_2$ (tMoS$_2$). By measuring the differential conductance ($dI/dV_{\text{Probe}}$) as a function of filling factor $ν$ and displacement field $D$, we observe a robust integer correlated insulating state at $ν= 1$ that persists across the measured displacement field range. Furthermore, we identify a displacement-field-induced fractional insulating state at $ν= 3/4$ for $D < -75$~mV/nm. Temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent measurements characterize this $ν= 3/4$ state as a potential generalized Wigner crystal. These correlated states are also observed in another device with a similar twist angle ($\approx 56.5^\circ$). Our results provide direct evidence of correlated states in near-AB-stacked tMoS$_2$ and establish QWRTD as a powerful experimental tool for investigating strong correlations and topology in van der Waals heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 该工作开发了量子阱共振隧穿二极管(QWRTD)作为新实验平台，探测~57°扭转双层MoS₂的电子结构，观测到ν=1整数关联绝缘态及位移场诱导的ν=3/4分数绝缘态。
AI.motivation: TMD摩尔超晶格是研究强电子关联涌现量子相的平台，需要新的实验手段探测近AB堆叠扭转双层MoS₂中的关联态与电子结构。
AI.method: 构建QWRTD器件，测量微分电导dI/dV_Probe随填充因子ν和位移场D的变化；并进行温度与磁场依赖测量。另在~56.5°扭转角的器件上复现。
AI.result: 在ν=1处观测到稳健的整数关联绝缘态，在整个测量位移场范围内持续存在；在D<-75 mV/nm时发现位移场诱导的ν=3/4分数绝缘态。温度与磁场测量表明ν=3/4态可能是广义Wigner晶体。另一器件中亦观测到这些关联态。
AI.conclusion: 提供了近AB堆叠tMoS₂中关联态的直接证据，并确立QWRTD为研究范德华异质结中强关联与拓扑的有力工具。

title: Defect Dynamics and Isomer Quenching in $^{229}$Th:CaF$_2$ Crystals
summary: Thorium-229 doped calcium fluoride ($^{229}$Th:CaF$_2$) is a leading candidate for a solid-state nuclear clock, owing to the unusually low energy of the $^{229}$Th isomer transition at 8.3557\,eV and the very high banggap of CaF$_2$ around 12\,eV. Here we report a temperature-dependent study of $^{229}$Th:CaF$_2$ luminescence, covering radioluminescence, photoluminescence, thermoluminescence, and afterglow. Using synchrotron x-ray excitation together with a cryo-vacuum system, we resolve the thermal quenching of the self-trapped exciton (STE) scintillation into its triplet and singlet components, identify eleven thermoluminescence glow peaks together with their associated emission bands, and separate the temperature-dependent components that make up the long-lived afterglow. The trap depths obtained in this way are closely correlated with the temperature dependence of x-ray-induced isomer quenching, including the enhanced isomer yield near \SI{-60}{\celsius} and the minimum near \SI{-80}{\celsius}, supporting the carrier-trapping picture in which trapped carriers are unavailable to quench the nucleus. Taken together, these results connect the optical and nuclear observables of $^{229}$Th:CaF$_2$ through a unified picture of electron defects and Th-related traps, while providing a comprehensive characterization of the material relevant to solid-state nuclear clock operation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过变温发光研究（辐射发光、光致发光、热致发光、余辉），揭示了^{229}Th:CaF_2中电子缺陷与Th相关陷阱的统一图像，并将其与核异构体淬灭的温度依赖行为关联，为固态核钟提供材料表征。
AI.motivation: ^{229}Th:CaF_2是固态核钟的领先候选材料（异构体跃迁能量低至8.3557 eV，CaF_2带隙约12 eV），但缺乏对其发光、缺陷与陷阱行为的系统理解，尤其是核观测与光学观测之间的联系尚不清晰。
AI.method: 使用同步辐射X射线激发与低温真空系统，对^{229}Th:CaF_2进行变温发光测量，涵盖辐射发光、光致发光、热致发光和余辉；分辨自陷激子（STE）闪烁的三重态与单态热淬灭，识别11个热致发光峰及对应发射带，并分离长寿命余辉的温度依赖成分。
AI.result: 获得了STE闪烁热淬灭的三重态/单态分量、11个热致发光辉峰及其发射带、以及余辉的温度依赖成分；所得陷阱深度与X射线诱导异构体淬灭的温度依赖性高度相关，包括约-60 °C处异构体产额增强和约-80 °C处出现极小值。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持载流子俘获图像（被俘获载流子无法淬灭原子核），通过电子缺陷与Th相关陷阱的统一图像将光学与核观测联系起来，并为固态核钟运行提供了全面的材料表征。

title: Smite: A quasiclassical trajectory (QCT) program for bimolecular collisions and unimolecular dynamics on ab-initio, and machine-learned potential energy surfaces
summary: We present Smite, a Python toolkit for quasiclassical trajectory (QCT) simulations of reactive and inelastic bimolecular collisions, unimolecular dynamics, and molecular collisions with finite surface models. A central feature is the explicit control of reactant preparation: harmonic normal modes admit fixed quantum numbers, prescribed energies, thermal quantum populations, or ground-state Wigner sampling; rotation is prepared at fixed angular-momentum magnitude or from thermal distributions appropriate to diatomic and polyatomic rotors. Rotating-Morse sampling provides a coupled anharmonic treatment of diatomic vibration and rotation, while saved molecular-dynamics phase points provide an alternative source of initial conditions. The same nuclear propagators operate with on-the-fly electronic-structure calculations or user-supplied analytical and machine-learned potential energy surfaces. Additional modules provide constrained rigid-fragment dynamics, thermostat-based preparation, photoionization initial conditions with energy and recoil constraints, and fewest-switches surface hopping (FSSH) on multiple PESs with approximate curvature-derived couplings. Geometry optimization, transition-state searches, crossing-point optimization, intrinsic-reaction-coordinate following, and thermochemistry use the same energy and derivative interfaces. Analysis tools connect trajectories to product energy partitioning, stereodynamical correlations, time-resolved vibrational signatures, and independent-atom x-ray scattering.

AI.tldr: Smite是一个用于准经典轨迹(QCT)模拟的Python工具包，支持双分子碰撞、单分子动力学及分子-表面碰撞等多类过程。
AI.motivation: 为准经典轨迹模拟提供一个统一、灵活的工具，解决反应物初始态精确控制、多种势能面接口以及轨迹后续分析的需求。
AI.method: 核心是反应物制备的显式控制：简谐正态振动模式支持固定量子数、指定能量、热布居或Wigner采样；转动支持固定角动量或热分布；提供转动-Morse采样处理双原子振动-转动耦合；支持存储的MD相点作为初始条件。核传播器兼容在线电子结构计算及用户提供的解析或机器学习势能面；附加模块包含约束刚性碎片动力学、恒温器制备、光离子化初始条件、基于多势能面的FSSH及曲率耦合；几何优化、过渡态、交叉点优化、IRC和热化学共用能量与导数接口。
AI.result: 工具整合了初始态制备、势能面接口、动力学传播及多种分析工具（产物能量分配、立体动力学关联、时间分辨振动特征、独立原子X射线散射）。
AI.conclusion: Smite提供了一个模块化、多功能的QCT模拟Python框架，覆盖从初始态制备到势能面计算再到轨迹分析的完整工作流。

title: Thermal magnon transport in FM/AFM bilayers
summary: Progress in information processing relies on spintronics, where magnetic states serve as efficient carriers for data storage and transfer. In this work, we theoretically study magnon propagation in a bilayer composed of a ferro-magnet and an antiferromagnet. For this purpose, we probe the spin Seebeck effect by introducing a spatially varying temperature profile. This generates a local magnon excitation and a continuous magnon flux from hot to cold regions which we quantify through the resulting non-equilibrium magnon accumulation. Based on the chirality of these modes, we identify specific constraints for magnon modes traveling either from the ferromagnet into the antiferromagnet or vice versa. A key finding is the observation of a thermally triggered spin current in the antiferromagnet, a phenomenon typically absent in bulk antiferromagnets that obey time-reversal symmetry. These results provide important insights into the design of heterostructures for magnonic chirality-selective spin transport.

AI.tldr: 本文理论上研究铁磁/反铁磁双层中磁振子的传播，通过自旋塞贝克效应诱导热驱动磁振子流，揭示手性约束及反铁磁体中热触发自旋流。
AI.motivation: 信息处理依赖自旋电子学，需要高效的数据存储与传输载体；探索铁磁/反铁磁异质结构中的磁振子手性选择输运机制具有重要价值。
AI.method: 引入空间变化温度分布探测自旋塞贝克效应，产生局域磁振子激发及从热区到冷区的连续磁振子流，通过非平衡磁振子积累进行量化，并基于模式手性分析传播约束。
AI.result: 识别出磁振子从铁磁到反铁磁（或反向）传播的特定手性约束；观测到反铁磁体中热触发的自旋流，该现象在遵守时间反演对称的块体反铁磁体中通常不存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究为设计磁振子手性选择自旋输运的异质结构提供了重要见解。

title: Weyl superconductivity from Feshbach resonance in the three-dimensional repulsive Hubbard model
summary: Motivated by the first experimental realization of the antiferromagnetic phase transition in the three-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model, we present a theoretical study of the model's 3D superconducting phase. By formulating a 3D extension of the Feshbach mechanism, we provide a unified microscopic picture at strong coupling in which pairing is driven by near-resonant bound states of dopants. These long-lived bound states acquire a qualitatively different internal structure in three dimensions compared to their two-dimensional counterparts, giving rise to a distinct superconducting state, namely a time-reversal symmetry breaking $d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{z^2}$ pairing state. We also provide an estimate of the corresponding critical temperature, and provide evidence that the resulting superconducting phase hosts gapless Weyl points. Our results represent a new milestone for the field of quantum simulation, challenging experiments and large-scale numerics alike to test our predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文在三维Fermi-Hubbard模型中提出Feshbach机制的三维推广，预言一种破缺时间反演对称的$d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{z^2}$超导态，并估计其临界温度，指出该相存在无质量Weyl点。
AI.motivation: 受三维Fermi-Hubbard模型中反铁磁相变首次实验实现的启发，作者希望从理论上研究该模型的三维超导相，填补实验进展对应的理论空白。
AI.method: 构造Feshbach机制的三维推广，在强耦合区给出统一微观图像：配对由掺杂粒子的近共振束缚态驱动；并分析这些长寿命束缚态在三维中与二维不同的内部结构。
AI.result: 三维束缚态结构导致一种与二维不同的超导态，即时间反演对称破缺的$d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{z^2}$配对态；作者还估计了相应临界温度，并提供证据表明该超导相具有无质量Weyl点。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为量子模拟领域设立新里程碑，向实验和大规模数值计算提出检验其预言的挑战。

title: First-Principles Study of Two-Dimensional CeN: Interplay between Structural Stability, Electronic Structure, and Magnetism
summary: In this work, the structural stability, and the electronic and magnetic properties of a novel CeN monolayer derived from the (111) surface of bulk rock salt CeN are investigated using first-principles calculations. Dimensional reduction produces substantial changes in the local atomic environment, decreasing the Ce-N coordination from sixfold in the bulk to threefold in the monolayer and shortening the Ce-N bond length, while preserving an essentially planar hexagonal structure. Moreover, the electronic and magnetic properties are significantly modified, which may be useful for practical applications. Both ferromagnetic (FM) and antiferromagnetic (AFM) configurations were investigated and found to be strongly bound, with the FM state slightly lower in energy. The magnetic moments are predominantly localized on the Ce atoms and mainly originated from the Ce 4f states. The electronic structure also exhibits a pronounced dependence on magnetic ordering, highlighting the connection between localized 4f states and the spin-dependent electronic properties of the system. In addition, the calculated elastic properties confirm the mechanical stability of the monolayer, while phonon calculations support its dynamical stability. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further indicate that the two-dimensional structure preserves its integrity under finite-temperature conditions. Overall, these results demonstrate that dimensional reduction significantly modifies the structural, electronic, and magnetic behavior of CeN without compromising the stability of the resulting two-dimensional lattice. The combination of structural robustness, localized Ce 4f magnetism, and spin-dependent electronic properties make the CeN monolayer an interesting system for further exploration in two-dimensional magnetism and spin-dependent applications.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理研究了由岩盐CeN(111)面衍生而来的新型CeN单层的结构稳定性及电子、磁性性质。
AI.motivation: 探索维度降低对CeN材料结构、电子和磁性的影响，寻找可用于二维磁性与自旋相关应用的新型二维材料。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，研究CeN单层的结构稳定性、电子与磁性；同时考察铁磁(FM)与反铁磁(AFM)构型，并结合弹性性质、声子计算和从头算分子动力学(AIMD)模拟。
AI.result: 维度降低使Ce-N配位数从六配位降至三配位并缩短键长，同时保持平面六角结构；FM与AFM均强结合，FM能量略低；磁矩主要局域在Ce原子并源于Ce 4f态；电子结构强烈依赖于磁序；弹性和声子计算确认力学与动力学稳定性；AIMD表明有限温度下结构保持完整。
AI.conclusion: 维度降低显著改变了CeN的结构、电子和磁性，同时不损害二维晶格稳定性；结构稳健、Ce 4f局域磁性与自旋依赖电子特性使其成为二维磁性和自旋相关应用的有前景体系。

title: Atomic-Scale Imaging of Lattice Relaxation and Topological Flat Bands in Helical Trilayer Graphene
summary: Helical trilayer graphene (HTG) has emerged as a highly tunable moire quantum material that hosts strong electronic correlations and nontrivial band topology. However, the atomic-scale lattice structure and local electronic properties have remained largely unexplored. Here we present a comprehensive real-space study of HTG using a combination of scanning near-field optical microscopy and low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy. We directly image supermoire lattice relaxation, revealing large triangular domains separated by sharp domain walls, as well as stripe domains connected by smoothly varying boundaries. Atomic-scale spectroscopy uncovers flat bands with a honeycomb electronic texture and one-dimensional boundary states confined to domain walls. By systematically varying the twist angle, we identify a magic angle of approximately 1.9°, substantially larger than the 1.6 degree predicted by theory. Our results establish a direct microscopic link between lattice relaxation and flat bands in HTG.

AI.tldr: 该文用近场光学显微镜与低温扫描隧道显微镜对螺旋三层石墨烯(HTG)进行实空间研究，直接观测到超莫尔晶格弛豫、平带与畴壁态，并测得约1.9°的魔角。
AI.motivation: HTG作为可调莫尔量子材料具有强关联与非平凡能带拓扑，但其原子尺度晶格结构与局域电子性质此前基本未被探索。
AI.method: 结合扫描近场光学显微镜与低温扫描隧道显微镜，对HTG进行系统的实空间成像与原子级光谱测量，并改变扭转角进行对比。
AI.result: 直接成像出超莫尔晶格弛豫：大三角形畴被尖锐畴壁分隔，以及由平滑边界连接的条纹畴；光谱揭示蜂窝状电子织构的平带和局限在畴壁的一维边界态；实验测得魔角约1.9°，明显大于理论预测的1.6°。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了HTG中晶格弛豫与平带之间的直接微观联系。

title: $μ$SR measurements of 3D Ising ferromagnetism in bulk Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ crystals
summary: Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ is a quasi-two-dimensional itinerant ferromagnet with a van-der-Waals layered structure that exhibits substantial magnetic anisotropy. In bulk samples, this material becomes magnetically ordered below 220~K, while in thin samples, the gate-tunability of the ferromagnetic moment has attracted significant interest. Alongside high-temperature ferromagnetism, a low-temperature magnetic state occurs whose nature has not been conclusively identified, with some studies suggesting a transition between ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism with temperature. Here we present magnetometry and $μ$SR data that demonstrate that Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ exhibits three-dimenional Ising-like ferromagnetism over the entire temperature range between $T_{C}=220$~K and 2~K. The feature at 170~K that has previously been proposed to be a transition to antiferromagnetism is instead likely to represent a domain-freezing transition.

AI.tldr: 本文通过磁强计和μSR测量表明，Fe₃GeTe₂在整个2-220 K温区均表现为三维Ising型铁磁性，170 K处的特征并非反铁磁转变，而是畴冻结转变。
AI.motivation: Fe₃GeTe₂薄样品中栅极可调的磁矩引起广泛兴趣，但低温磁态的本质尚未确定，此前有研究认为随温度降低存在铁磁到反铁磁的转变，需加以澄清。
AI.method: 采用磁强计测量与μSR（μ子自旋弛豫）实验，对Fe₃GeTe₂在整个温区（2-220 K）的磁性质进行研究。
AI.result: 实验数据显示，Fe₃GeTe₂在整个温区内均呈现三维Ising型铁磁性，居里温度TC=220 K，直至2 K无铁磁-反铁磁转变。
AI.conclusion: 此前提出的170 K反铁磁转变特征实为畴冻结转变，该工作澄清了Fe₃GeTe₂低温磁态的本质。

title: Operando Charge Carrier Dynamics by Intensity-Modulated Photoluminescence: From Perovskite Thin Films to Solar Cells
summary: The charge-carrier lifetime in halide perovskites often varies by orders of magnitude with the injection level, complicating the analysis of conventional time-resolved photoluminescence and comparisons of reported lifetimes. We use intensity-modulated photoluminescence spectroscopy (IMPLS) as a frequency-domain alternative. Carried out under operating conditions, it yields the lifetime at a specific injection level, e.g., one-sun-equivalent illumination. On thin films, IMPLS and steady-state photoluminescence yield comparable lifetimes. For perovskite/transport-layer stacks, the IMPLS response becomes more complex. A dedicated transfer function disentangles charge transfer from interface recombination and predicts an upper limit on the charge-carrier lifetime in the solar cell. In devices, electrical methods such as intensity-modulated photovoltage spectroscopy (IMVS) often fail to measure the lifetime due to capacitive effects. IMPLS shows not only the same two characteristic frequencies as IMVS, but also a third one, thereby resolving the lifetime itself.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用强度调制光致发光谱(IMPLS)作为频域方法，在特定注入水平(如1个太阳当量)下测定卤化物钙钛矿的载流子寿命，克服了寿命随注入水平大幅变化带来的分析困难。
AI.motivation: 卤化物钙钛矿的载流子寿命随注入水平变化可达数量级差异，导致传统时间分辨光致发光分析复杂、不同报道寿命难以比较。
AI.method: 采用强度调制光致发光谱(IMPLS)进行频域测量；针对钙钛矿/传输层叠层结构，引入传递函数以区分电荷转移与界面复合；在器件中与强度调制光电压谱(IMVS)对比。
AI.result: 在薄膜上IMPLS与稳态光致发光给出可比寿命；对叠层器件，专用传递函数分离电荷转移与界面复合，并预测电池中载流子寿命上限；器件中IMVS受电容效应影响常无法测寿命，而IMPLS不仅显示与IMVS相同的两个特征频率，还出现第三个频率，从而直接解析出寿命。
AI.conclusion: IMPLS是一种可靠的工作条件下频域寿命表征手段，能解耦界面复合、给出寿命上限，并在器件中克服电容效应成功测定载流子寿命。

title: Strong Dimerization and Field-Induced Reconstruction of the Low-Energy Spectrum in $\mathrm{Cu}_3(\mathrm{OH})_4(\mathrm{HCO}_2)_2$
summary: We investigate the field-dependent low-energy thermodynamics of the distorted triangular quantum antiferromagnet $\mathrm{Cu}_3(\mathrm{OH})_4(\mathrm{HCO}_2)_2$ using a sector-resolved Superblock Diagonalization Method (SBDM) supplemented by a transfer-matrix treatment of weakly coupled layers. The strong exchange hierarchy, dominated by the Cu1--Cu1 intradimer coupling $J_2=150\,\mathrm{K}$, separates a high-energy dimer sector from a much softer magnetic manifold formed predominantly by the Cu2 moments. In the 24-site cluster, sixteen Cu1 spins form the strongly bound sector while eight Cu2 spins remain magnetically active; polarization of these eight spins gives $S^z=4$ compared with $S^z_{\rm sat}=12$, providing a direct microscopic origin for the one-third magnetization scale. The finite-temperature thermodynamics reveals a non-monotonic field evolution of the low-energy scale: the dominant $C/T$ feature softens with increasing field, reaches a minimum near the field region around $2\,\mathrm{T}$, and subsequently hardens as the low-temperature magnetization approaches $M_{\rm sat}/3$. Temperature and field sweeps thus expose a common field-induced spectral reconstruction, while the strongly reduced entropy reflects the restricted number of thermally active degrees of freedom below the dimer excitation scale. Our results identify strong-dimer-induced reduction of the active magnetic Hilbert space, followed by field-driven reorganization of the residual spin sector, as the common microscopic origin of the one-third magnetic response and the non-monotonic low-temperature thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文用SBDM方法研究Cu₃(OH)₄(HCO₂)₂的场依赖低温热力学，揭示三分之一磁化平台与低能标非单调演化源于强二聚体压缩活性磁空间及磁场诱导残余自旋重构。
AI.motivation: 澄清扭曲三角量子反铁磁体中三分之一磁化响应的微观来源，以及其低温热力学非单调场演化的机制。
AI.method: 采用分区分辨的超块对角化方法(SBDM)，辅以弱耦合层的转移矩阵处理；在24格点团簇中，16个强束缚Cu1自旋与8个磁性活跃Cu2自旋被区分处理。
AI.result: 八个Cu2自旋极化给出Sᶻ=4（对比饱和值12），直接给出三分之一磁化的微观来源；主导C/T特征随场增加先软化、约2 T处达最小、随后硬化。熵显著减小反映二聚体激发标度以下热活性自由度受限。
AI.conclusion: 强二聚体诱导的活性磁Hilbert空间缩减，叠加磁场驱动的残余自旋扇区重组，是三分之一磁响应与低温热力学非单调行为的共同微观起源。

title: Three-Dimensional Topology from Stacking-Controlled Umklapp Scattering in Large-Angle Twisted Graphite
summary: Large-angle twisted graphene lies beyond the local-stacking description of conventional moiré systems: inequivalent rotation centers define distinct commensurate interfaces whose low-energy interlayer hybridization is governed by intervalley Umklapp tunneling. For three-dimensional twisted graphite assembled from interfaces with different crystalline symmetries, a symmetry-constrained effective model reveals that competition between nonchiral and chiral tunneling produces one-ring and two-ring nodal-line phases and a $C_3$-protected higher-order topological insulator in the presence of sublattice (chiral) symmetry. The nodal rings carry integer winding numbers, allowing oppositely wound rings to annihilate into the gapped phase. We further examine how sublattice-symmetry breaking modifies these phases. Density functional theory (DFT) and atomistic calculations for $21.8^\circ$ twisted graphite identify the equilibrium structure as a higher-order topological insulator, while compression drives it into a topological Weyl semimetal phase. These findings establish the stacking sequence of symmetry-inequivalent interfaces as a means of engineering band topology in three-dimensional twisted structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大角度扭转石墨，发现由不同对称性界面堆叠而成的三层扭转结构可通过非手性与手性隧穿竞争产生节线相与高阶拓扑绝缘体，并预测压缩可诱导拓扑Weyl半金属相。
AI.motivation: 传统莫尔体系的局域堆叠描述不适用于大角度扭转石墨，其低能层间杂化由区间Umklapp隧穿主导，需要新的有效模型来理解三维扭转结构的能带拓扑。
AI.method: 构建受对称性约束的有效模型描述不同晶格对称性界面堆叠的三维扭转石墨，并结合DFT与原子级计算对21.8°扭转石墨进行研究。
AI.result: 非手性与手性隧穿竞争产生单环、双环节线相及受C3保护的高阶拓扑绝缘体；节线环具整数缠绕数可相互湮灭；21.8°扭转石墨平衡结构为高阶拓扑绝缘体，压缩下转变为拓扑Weyl半金属。
AI.conclusion: 对称性不等价界面的堆叠顺序可作为三维扭转结构中能带拓扑的调控手段。

title: Topological Transverse Transport without a Gap in Critical Topological Flat Bands
summary: Quantized Hall transport is traditionally anchored to a bulk spectral gap, which isolates the occupied subspace and exponentially suppresses thermal deviations. Recently discovered critical topological flat bands (CTFBs) challenge this paradigm: an exactly flat band touches a dispersive continuum while retaining a well-defined integer Chern number. However, their finite-temperature transverse transport properties remain entirely unexplored. Here, we develop a low-temperature theory of the intrinsic electrical, thermoelectric, and thermal Hall responses in CTFBs. At fixed particle number, the macroscopic flat-band degeneracy forces a singular Lambert-$W$ drift of the chemical potential, generating an algebraic-logarithmic hierarchy of low-temperature corrections: $T\ln(1/T)$ for electrical Hall, $T[\ln(1/T)]^2$ for thermoelectric Hall, and $T[\ln(1/T)]^3$ for thermal Hall conductivity, replacing the activated thermal protection of a gapped Chern insulator. By contrast, externally pinning the chemical potential to the flat-band energy locks the flat band to half occupation at any nonzero temperature, obstructing the recovery of the fully filled topological ground state as $T\to0^+$. Our results establish that a bulk spectral gap is unnecessary for zero-temperature Hall quantization, but indispensable for its exponential thermal protection.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了临界拓扑平带(CTFB)在有限温度下的电、热电与热霍尔响应理论，揭示平带宏观简并导致化学势发生奇异的Lambert-W漂移，产生代数-对数型低温修正，从而表明霍尔量子化无需体能隙，但指数级热保护必须依赖能隙。
AI.motivation: 传统量子化霍尔输运依赖体能隙以隔离占据子空间并指数抑制热激发。新发现的临界拓扑平带具有确定整数陈数却与色散连续谱接触，其有限温度横向输运性质完全未知，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 发展CTFB中本征电霍尔、热电霍尔与热霍尔响应的低温理论，固定粒子数时分析平带宏观简并对化学势的约束，导出其Lambert-W漂移行为及各级低温修正；并对比外部钉扎化学势的情形。
AI.result: 固定粒子数下，平带简并迫使化学势发生奇异Lambert-W漂移，产生代数-对数层级修正：电霍尔为T·ln(1/T)，热电霍尔为T·[ln(1/T)]²，热霍尔为T·[ln(1/T)]³，取代了有隙陈绝缘体的激活式热保护。若将化学势钉扎于平带能量，则平带在任何非零温下被锁定在半占据，阻碍T→0⁺时恢复完全填充的拓扑基态。
AI.conclusion: 霍尔量子化在零温下不依赖体能隙，但指数级热保护必须以体能隙为前提。

title: Entropy-Driven Altermagnetism from Thermal Magnons
summary: We identify a route to altermagnetism driven by entropy upon heating and demonstrate it in a minimal square-lattice antiferromagnet. An exchange modulation is entropically favored because the resulting momentum-dependent magnon splitting increases the magnon entropy, thereby lowering the free energy and favoring altermagnetism. We derive an instability criterion for this exchange-modulated state, predict its temperature-driven reentrant behavior, and show that its overlap with Néel order defines a finite-temperature altermagnetic phase. Variational spin-wave theory, spin--lattice Monte Carlo, and cluster diagonalization establish the entropy-driven instability and its coexistence with magnetic order. The resulting state supports a transverse spin conductivity. The mechanism provides a route to thermally induced altermagnetism in compensated magnets coupled to sufficiently soft physical modes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种由熵驱动、通过加热实现的交变磁性（altermagnetism）机制，并在最小方格反铁磁体中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 探索如何在补偿磁体中实现交变磁性，尤其是由热涨落/熵而非传统相互作用驱动的机制，为有限温度下的交变磁性相提供新途径。
AI.method: 采用变分自旋波理论、自旋-晶格蒙特卡洛模拟以及团簇对角化方法；推导交换调制态的不稳定性判据，并分析其温度驱动的回归行为。
AI.result: 交换调制因动量依赖的磁振子劈裂增加磁振子熵而被熵所偏好，降低自由能并利于交变磁性；其与Néel序重叠形成有限温度交变磁性相，并支持横向自旋电导。
AI.conclusion: 该机制为与足够软的物理模式耦合的补偿磁体中热诱导交变磁性提供了可行路径。

title: Nature of the 175-180 cm$^{-1}$ Raman Feature in Altermagnetic $α$-MnTe
summary: The 175 cm$^{-1}$ Raman mode in $α$-MnTe has long been assigned to the material's only symmetry-allowed phonon ($E_{2g}$), yet first-principles calculations consistently place this mode below 100 cm$^{-1}$. Recent works have offered three competing explanations for the discrepancy: a weak symmetry-lowering ($D_{6h}\rightarrow D_{3h}$) phonon, an electronic plasmon arising from intrinsic hole self-doping, or an extrinsic MnTe$_2$ impurity signature. Here we resolve this controversy using stoichiometry-controlled molecular beam epitaxy (MBE). We deliberately vary the fraction of pyrite-type MnTe$_2$ secondary phase relative to the $α$-MnTe matrix. Across this series, the 175 cm$^{-1}$ mode tracks the presence of MnTe$_2$ essentially one-to-one -- present wherever MnTe$_2$ is detectable, absent in stoichiometric, single-phase $α$-MnTe at nominal LASER powers. When LASER power is ramped up, an additional mode emerges in MnTe as well positioned close to $\approx$ 175 cm$^{-1}$; our detailed temperatures dependendent Raman analysis identifies the LASER power scorched region close to a distorted MnTe phase, confirmed via transmission electron microscopy. This direct, growth-controlled correlation identifies the mode as an extrinsic MnTe$_2$ impurity signature or as a distorted MnTe feature, rather than an intrinsic phonon or plasmon feature, providing a practical diagnostic for phase purity in MBE-grown $α$-MnTe and clarifying which Raman features can be reliably attributed to the intrinsic altermagnetic phase.

AI.tldr: 通过化学计量控制的MBE生长，证明α-MnTe中175 cm⁻¹拉曼模与MnTe₂杂质相或激光诱发的畸变MnTe相关，而非本征声子或等离激元。
AI.motivation: α-MnTe中175 cm⁻¹拉曼模长期被归为唯一的对称允许声子(E₂g)，但第一性原理计算将该模置于100 cm⁻¹以下。已有三种竞争解释（对称性降低声子、空穴自掺杂等离激元、MnTe₂杂质），需澄清该争议。
AI.method: 采用化学计量控制的分子束外延(MBE)，人为改变黄铁矿型MnTe₂次相相对于α-MnTe基体的比例；结合变温拉曼分析与透射电子显微镜(TEM)表征。
AI.result: 175 cm⁻¹模与MnTe₂的存在几乎一一对应：凡可探测到MnTe₂处即出现，在化学计量单相α-MnTe中（标称激光功率下）消失。提高激光功率时MnTe中也会出现接近175 cm⁻¹的新模，变温拉曼与TEM证实其源于激光烧蚀区附近的畸变MnTe相。
AI.conclusion: 该模应归因于外来的MnTe₂杂质特征或畸变MnTe特征，而非本征声子或等离激元。这为MBE生长的α-MnTe相纯度提供了实用诊断手段，并明确了哪些拉曼特征可可靠归属本征交替磁相。

title: Long-lived divergence from equilibrium of electrons, nuclear spins and lattice for a solid state ion trap at low temperature
summary: A fundamental problem in physics as well as engineering is equilibration. For example, the regulation of thermal and quantum fluctuations enables thermal and quantum annealing of complex systems. A key question is how different subsystems, such as electrons, nuclear spins and phonons equilibrate on their own as well as with each other. Level crossings play a special role in the dynamics of coupled degrees of freedom, for it is here that entanglement can be maximized to speed up relaxation. Here we use optical methods to establish the electronuclear level scheme, including avoided and unavoided crossings, and to examine equilibration of a rare earth ion (Ho$^{3+}$) in a salt (LiYF$_4$), a model system with quantum fluctuations which can be tuned via an external magnetic field transverse to the crystallographic long axis of the tetragonal host. We track the state of the system by monitoring the populations of the levels as a function of swept longitudinal fields, and discover that at low temperatures, depending on the experimental protocol, vastly different non-equilibrium states arise. We find evidence that nuclear spin excitations diffuse and equilibrate without the assistance of phonons, and tend to acquire higher effective temperatures than the electronic spins and the yet cooler lattice. A theory of thermally assisted tunneling rules out the standard scenario of phonon -assisted tunneling, and instead suggests that fast dynamics at level anti-crossings are facilitated entirely by nuclear spin diffusion. This provides a new understanding of thermalization and related slow relaxation phenomena in dense, multi-component interacting quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 利用光学方法研究LiYF₄中Ho³⁺的电子-核能级结构（含避免/非避免交叉），揭示核自旋激发无需声子辅助即可扩散平衡，并可获得比电子自旋和晶格更高的有效温度，提出热辅助隧穿新机制。
AI.motivation: 平衡化（equilibration）是物理与工程的基本问题，不同子系统（电子、核自旋、声子）如何各自及相互平衡尚不清楚；能级交叉处纠缠可最大化、加速弛豫，是理解耦合自由度动力学的关键。
AI.method: 以LiYF₄中的Ho³⁺为模型体系，通过光学方法确定电子-核能级图（避免与非避免交叉）；施加横向磁场调节量子涨落，纵向磁场扫描并监测能级布居随时间演化，比较不同实验协议下的非平衡态；用"热辅助隧穿"理论分析机制。
AI.result: 低温下不同实验协议产生截然不同的非平衡态；发现核自旋激发可独立于声子扩散并平衡，且趋向于比电子自旋和晶格更高的有效温度；理论排除了标准声子辅助隧穿图像。
AI.conclusion: 能级反交叉处的快速动力学完全由核自旋扩散驱动，为稠密多组分相互作用量子体系的热化及慢弛豫现象提供了新理解。

title: Impurity-induced Friedel oscillations and Wigner crystallization in Luttinger liquids via Unified Field Bosonization Technique
summary: We present an analytical study of impurity-induced density correlations in interacting one-dimensional Luttinger liquids using the Unified Field Bosonization Technique (UFBT). Unlike conventional approaches that treat impurities perturbatively, UFBT incorporates localized impurities exactly at the free-fermion level while treating interactions non-perturbatively. Closed analytical expressions for fermionic Green functions and density-density correlation functions are obtained for strongly inhomogeneous systems, enabling a unified description of the impurity-induced $2k_F$ Friedel oscillations and the $4k_F$ Wigner-crystal like correlations. The corresponding scaling behaviour is derived analytically, revealing a crossover in the dominant long-distance correlations at $g=1/3$: Friedel correlations dominate for $g>1/3$, whereas Wigner-crystal like correlations become dominant for $g<1/3$, corresponding to the regime of sufficiently strong repulsive interactions. A reflection-coupled harmonic analysis is developed to account for the left-right mixing induced by impurity backscattering and to consistently reproduce the resulting density correlations. The spinless limit is also obtained as a direct reduction of the spinful formulation. These results provide an analytically controlled framework for describing impurity-induced and interaction-driven density correlations in strongly inhomogeneous one-dimensional quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 用UFBT方法精确处理杂质、非微扰处理相互作用，解析得到一维Luttinger液体中杂质诱导的密度关联，发现g=1/3处Friedel(2k_F)与Wigner(4k_F)关联主导地位发生交叉。
AI.motivation: 传统方法对杂质做微扰处理，难以描述强非均匀一维系统中杂质与相互作用共同驱动的密度关联。
AI.method: 采用统一场玻色化技术(UFBT)：在自由费米子层面精确纳入局域杂质，非微扰处理相互作用；给出费米子格林函数与密度-密度关联的闭式解析表达式；发展反射耦合谐振分析处理杂质背散射导致的左右混合；并由自旋形式直接约化出无自旋极限。
AI.result: 得到强非均匀系统下杂质诱导2k_F Friedel振荡与4k_F Wigner晶体式关联的统一描述及解析标度行为；发现g=1/3处交叉：g>1/3时Friedel关联主导，g<1/3(强排斥)时Wigner晶体式关联主导。
AI.conclusion: 为强非均匀一维量子系统中杂质诱导与相互作用驱动的密度关联提供了可解析控制的统一框架。

title: Surface-Dependent Phonon Dynamics in 9-Armchair Graphene Nanoribbon Arrays
summary: We use temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy to investigate five configurations of atomically precise 9-armchair graphene nanoribbons (9-AGNRs) differing in substrate, alignment, and coverage. Measurements from 70 to 300 K and full-window Lorentzian fits yield the positions and linewidths of the radial-breathing-like mode (RBLM), confinement-activated $D$, and $G$ modes. The $D$ and $G$ modes soften on heating at configuration-dependent rates. For the same unaligned high-coverage film before and after polymer-free transfer, measured $D$- and $G$-mode redshift rates are smaller on the Raman-optimised substrate than on Au by factors of 4.7 and 5.6, respectively. We model the frequency shifts as thermoelastic contributions from substrate-ribbon thermal-expansion mismatch plus a Klemens-type anharmonic term. Between 80 and 290 K, the model gives $D$- and $G$-mode redshifts from $0.305$ to $6.322~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$, whereas the zero-K-referenced Klemens-type contribution remains below $0.050~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$. Under the adopted assumptions, thermal-expansion mismatch therefore dominates these shifts. The modelled RBLM change remains below $1~\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$ and cannot be robustly separated into its two contributions. The dense aligned Au array additionally shows intermediate-temperature minima in the $D$- and $G$-mode linewidths, inconsistent with conventional monotonic anharmonic broadening and indicating an additional temperature-dependent broadening or line-shape contribution.

AI.tldr: 用变温拉曼光谱研究五种9-AGNR构型，发现D、G模随温度红移主要源于衬底与条带热膨胀失配，而非克莱门斯型非谐效应。
AI.motivation: 原子级精确石墨烯纳米带的热学与振动性质受衬底、取向和覆盖度影响，但其拉曼峰温变机制（热膨胀失配vs非谐效应）尚不清楚，需系统实验与建模加以区分。
AI.method: 在70–300 K对五种9-AGNR构型（不同衬底、取向、覆盖度）做变温拉曼，用全窗口洛伦兹拟合提取RBLM、D、G模位置与线宽；将频移建模为衬底-条带热膨胀失配的热弹性项加Klemens型非谐项，并对比转移前后同一薄膜在Au与拉曼优化衬底上的结果。
AI.result: D、G模随加热软化且速率依赖构型；同一样品转移前后，拉曼优化衬底上D、G模红移速率分别比Au小4.7倍和5.6倍。80–290 K模型给出D、G红移0.305–6.322 cm⁻¹，而零K参考的非谐贡献小于0.050 cm⁻¹；RBLM变化小于1 cm⁻¹且无法可靠分离两种贡献。密集取向Au阵列的D、G线宽在中间温度出现极小值。
AI.conclusion: 在所采用假设下，热膨胀失配主导D、G模温致红移，非谐贡献很小；RBLM无法分离贡献；中间温度线宽极小值表明存在常规单调非谐展宽之外的额外温度相关展宽或线形贡献。

title: Quantization through Dissipation and the Optical Quantum Hall Effect
summary: The integer quantum Hall effect remains the most paradigmatic and remarkable example of exact quantization in condensed matter physics. Its Hall conductivity $σ_{xy}$ is fixed to $e^2/h$ times an integer to a precision limited only by measurement and independent of disorder or interactions. This robustness has several explanations, each capturing a strikingly different piece of the physics. In Laughlin's gauge argument, flux insertion pumps an integer charge between edges, so quantization follows from gauge invariance alone. The edge-channel picture instead attributes transport to chiral, ballistic 1D channels at the sample boundary, one per filled Landau level. Bulk arguments tie $σ_{xy}$ to a topological invariant of the disordered system, with extended states compensating exactly for the current not carried by localized ones. Here we demonstrate an additional route to understanding quantization, rooted in the finite-frequency dissipative electrodynamics of the bulk. Using high-precision terahertz Faraday rotation and numerics, we show that the cyclotron resonance alone does not give quantized plateaus under Kramers-Kronig transformation. Quantization is recovered only once a faint, low-frequency, topologically enforced dissipative contribution from impurity states is included. This dynamical mechanism, hiding in plain sight within the dissipative response, ties the DC value to the finite-frequency optical response and offers a new route to quantization through the optical Hall effect.

AI.tldr: 本文通过太赫兹法拉第旋转与数值计算，揭示整数量子霍尔效应中电导量子化源于有限频率耗散电动力学：仅靠回旋共振无法给出量子化平台，必须计入杂质态提供的微弱低频拓扑性耗散贡献。
AI.motivation: 整数霍尔电导的精确量子化虽已有Laughlin规范论证、边缘通道、体拓扑不变量等多种解释，但每种仅捕捉不同侧面。作者希望找到一条根植于体态有限频率耗散电动力学的新理解路径，把直流量子化与光学响应联系起来。
AI.method: 采用高精度太赫兹法拉第旋转测量，并结合数值计算，对回旋共振等响应做Kramers-Kronig变换，检验其能否产生量子化平台；再引入杂质态的低频耗散贡献进行分析。
AI.result: 发现仅回旋共振在Kramers-Kronig变换下无法给出量子化平台；只有在加入由杂质态产生、受拓扑强制约束的微弱低频耗散贡献后，量子化才被恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该动力学机制隐藏在耗散响应之中，将直流电导值与有限频率光学响应联系起来，为通过光学霍尔效应理解量子化提供了新途径。

title: Probing Collective and Individual Kondo Screening: Multi-Stage, Multi-Channel Kondo Effects in a $C_3$-Symmetric Four-Impurity Model
summary: Collective screening has been proposed to underlie the basic physics of multi-impurity and lattice Kondo systems. But how to establish this picture and distinguish it from individual (local) Kondo screening remains a grand challenge. The recently developed auxiliary-bath numerical renormalization group (AUNRG) method provides a key step towards resolving this issue. Its application to the $C_3$-symmetric three-impurity Kondo (3IK) model with a shared electron bath reveals fully screened Fermi liquid ground states arising from collective screening of cluster spin degrees of freedom at small Kondo coupling $J_{\rm K}$ and individual (local) screening of local impurities at large $J_{\rm K}$. Here we design a four-impurity Kondo (4IK) model where the probe impurity couples only to the original three Kondo impurities to detect the nature of the screened states. We show that the collective and individual Kondo screenings give rise to emergent multi-stage, two-channel Kondo effect and unstable three-channel Kondo effect, respectively. This suggests a special helicity structure of the screened states and confirms the idea of collective screening in multi-impurity Kondo systems. Our work also demonstrates that the same auxiliary-bath construction can be readily extended to models with additional impurities to explore novel many-body quantum states with emergent cluster degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 通过设计四杂质Kondo模型区分集体与个体Kondo屏蔽，发现二者分别导致多级两通道Kondo效应与不稳定的三通道Kondo效应。
AI.motivation: 集体屏蔽被认为是多杂质和晶格Kondo系统基础物理的核心，但如何确立这一图像并与个体（局域）Kondo屏蔽区分开来仍是重大挑战。已有AUNRG方法对三杂质Kondo模型的成功应用提供了关键进展，但需要进一步设计模型来探测被屏蔽态的本质。
AI.method: 设计四杂质Kondo（4IK）模型，其中探针杂质仅与原有的三个Kondo杂质耦合，利用辅助浴数值重整化群（AUNRG）方法研究被屏蔽态的性质。
AI.result: 集体Kondo屏蔽产生涌现的多级两通道Kondo效应，而个体（局域）Kondo屏蔽产生不稳定的三通道Kondo效应。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明被屏蔽态具有特殊的螺旋结构，证实了多杂质Kondo系统中集体屏蔽的思想。同时证明辅助浴构造可推广到含额外杂质的模型，以探索具有涌现团簇自由度的新奇多体量子态。

title: Realization of ZnSe-based Field-Effect Transistors operating at Cryogenic Temperatures as a Platform for Future Spin-Qubit Applications
summary: The wide-bandgap compound semiconductor ZnSe is a promising host material for the realization of electron spin-qubits. Its non-degenerate conduction band and the potential for isotopic nuclear spin purification promise long spin coherence times. Key requirements for such devices include reliable electrostatic control of electrons in ZnSe and low-resistance ohmic contacts that remain functional at cryogenic temperatures. In this work, we utilize a novel Shadow Wall technique for molecular-beam epitaxy combined with in-situ deposition of Al ohmic contacts to realize normally-off ZnSe-based field-effect transistors. The devices exhibit linear output characteristics and effective gate control of the channel from room temperature down to 5 K, confirming low-resistance ohmic contacts to the undoped ZnSe channel. The drain current can be modulated by several orders of magnitude through electrostatic gating, with threshold voltages of approximately 3 V and field-effect mobilities exceeding 100 cm2/Vs over the investigated temperature range. Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson and drift-diffusion simulations reproduce the measured transfer characteristics and provide insight into the role of interface electrostatics in determining the channel formation and threshold voltage. These results demonstrate the potential of gated ZnSe heterostructures for future spin-qubit applications.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用新型Shadow Wall分子束外延技术结合原位Al欧姆接触沉积，实现了常闭型ZnSe基场效应晶体管，在室温至5 K范围内表现出良好栅控与低阻欧姆接触，验证了ZnSe门控异质结构用于自旋量子比特的潜力。
AI.motivation: ZnSe是宽禁带化合物半导体，具有非简并导带和同位素核自旋纯化潜力，可实现长自旋相干时间，是电子自旋量子比特的理想宿主材料。但器件需要可靠的ZnSe电子静电控制以及在低温下仍保持功能的低阻欧姆接触。
AI.method: 采用新型Shadow Wall分子束外延技术，并结合原位Al欧姆接触沉积，制备常闭型ZnSe基场效应晶体管；同时使用自洽薛定谔-泊松与漂移-扩散模拟分析器件特性。
AI.result: 器件表现出线性输出特性和有效的栅控能力（从室温至5 K），确认了对未掺杂ZnSe沟道的低阻欧姆接触；漏电流可通过静电栅控调制数个数量级，阈值电压约3 V，场效应迁移率在整个温度范围内超过100 cm²/Vs；模拟结果与实测转移特性吻合。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了门控ZnSe异质结构在未来自旋量子比特应用中的潜力。

title: adapol: Adaptive pole-fitting for quantum many-body physics
summary: We describe adapol, a Python package for fitting Matsubara Green's functions, self-energies, and hybridization functions by a compact sum of simple poles with real pole locations and matrix-valued residues. This pole-fitting step arises in many contexts, including hybridization fitting for quantum impurity solvers based on exact diagonalization, perturbation theory, and tensor networks, the compression of existing pole expansions such as the discrete Lehmann representation, diagrammatic methods based on discrete pole representations, and the analytic continuation of Matsubara Green's functions. adapol uses a modified version of the AAA rational approximation algorithm to estimate pole locations, and non-convex optimization to refine them. This procedure yields accurate and compact fits in a black-box and noise-robust manner. adapol provides a simple, self-contained interface with extensive documentation and examples, as well as an interface to the TRIQS package.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 adapol，一个用于将 Matsubara 格林函数、自能和杂化函数拟合成紧凑的简单极点展开（实极点 + 矩阵留数）的 Python 软件包。
AI.motivation: 极点拟合在多体物理中广泛出现，如量子杂质求解器的杂化拟合、离散 Lehmann 表示压缩、图解方法和解析延拓等，需要一个准确、紧凑且鲁棒的通用拟合工具。
AI.method: adapol 采用改进的 AAA 有理逼近算法估计极点位置，再用非凸优化进行精修，从而实现黑箱、抗噪的拟合过程。
AI.result: 该程序能获得准确且紧凑的拟合结果，并以黑箱、抗噪的方式运行；提供简单自包含的接口、详尽文档与示例，以及与 TRIQS 包的接口。
AI.conclusion: adapol 为多种 Matsubara 函数极点拟合场景提供了一个实用、易用且鲁棒的 Python 工具。

title: First-Principles Study of I$_2$ and CH$_3$I Adsorption on Transition Metal Decorated 2D-Material substrates : Insights from Electronic Structure and Reaction Kinetics
summary: Radioactive iodine species, particularly I$_2$ and CH$_3$I, pose significant environmental and technological hazards owing to their high volatility, chemical stability, and relatively weak interaction with traditional substrate and sorption materials. In this work, we proposed a series of transition-metal (TM) (Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn) decorated boron-doped graphene (BDG) and 2D-MoTe2 substrates for efficient adsorptive capture and mitigation of such volatile Iodine species. Using systematic first-principles density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we elucidate the microscopic origin of the enhanced adsorption by analyzing the changes in the electronic structure upon adsorption. More importantly, we analyzed the thermodynamic and kinetic feasibility of adsorption on these newly designed substrates using Climbing-Image Nudged Elastic band (CI-NEB) calculations and found that TM decoration serves as an effective catalytic center, thereby making the reaction thermodynamically and kinetically feasible. Conversely, the reaction becomes thermodynamically and kinetically unfavorable on pristine substrates in the absence of a TM atom as a catalytic center. This work deepens our understanding of the electronic origin of the enhanced adsorption and reaction kinetics, and the predictions made will be useful for experimental realization.

AI.tldr: 本文用DFT研究过渡金属(Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn)修饰的硼掺杂石墨烯和2D-MoTe2对放射性碘物种(I2, CH3I)的吸附捕获，发现TM修饰作为催化中心使吸附在热力学和动力学上可行。
AI.motivation: 放射性碘物种(I2、CH3I)具有高挥发性、化学稳定性，且与传统基底和吸附材料相互作用弱，带来显著环境与技术危害，亟需高效的吸附捕获材料。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论(DFT)系统计算，通过分析吸附前后电子结构变化揭示增强吸附的微观来源；并用爬坡微动弹性带(CI-NEB)方法分析吸附的热力学与动力学可行性。
AI.result: TM(Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn)修饰的BDG和2D-MoTe2能有效增强吸附；TM修饰充当催化中心，使反应在热力学和动力学上均可行；而无TM原子的原始基底上反应在热力学和动力学上均不利。
AI.conclusion: 该工作深化了对增强吸附及反应动力学电子起源的理解，其预测结果有助于实验实现。

title: Designing Strongly Correlated Quantum Phases of Matter with Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States
summary: Designing a material with a desired property amounts to solving an inverse problem: finding the couplings of a microscopic Hamiltonian whose ground state exhibits that property. For strongly correlated quantum systems, solving this problem efficiently remains largely out of reach. To address this challenge, we present a general framework for ab initio inverse design based on Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States, a recent approach in which the ground states of a family of Hamiltonians are encoded in a single variational wave function. Because the ansatz depends explicitly on the couplings, any target property is a differentiable function of them, and the search for the right Hamiltonian reduces to gradient-based optimization in coupling space. We apply this approach to search for nonmagnetic phases of frustrated Heisenberg models on the square lattice with an increasing number of free next-nearest-neighbor couplings, aiming to identify new quantum spin liquid candidates. With a single coupling, the method recovers the known nonmagnetic window of the square $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model, whereas letting the two diagonal couplings vary independently reveals an extended nonmagnetic region connecting the square-lattice and anisotropic-triangular-lattice regimes. In a search space of eight independent couplings within a $2\times2$ unit cell, which contains several paradigmatic frustrated spin models, the optimization spontaneously converges to the $J_1$-$J_2$-$δ$ Heisenberg model, in which the diagonal couplings alternate between two values on neighboring plaquettes, a model recently proposed in the context of altermagnetism. Finite-size scaling up to $16\times16$ clusters in this optimal model shows that the ground state has no magnetic, dimer, or plaquette order, establishing it as a new quantum spin liquid candidate, distinct from those previously proposed on the square lattice.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Foundation神经网络量子态的从头算逆向设计框架，通过耦合空间梯度优化寻找非磁相，发现新型方格子量子自旋液体候选模型 $J_1$-$J_2$-$δ$。
AI.motivation: 设计具有目标性质的材料本质上是逆向问题，即寻找微观哈密顿量耦合使基态呈现该性质；对强关联量子系统，高效求解此问题基本不可行。
AI.method: 基于Foundation神经网络量子态框架，将一族哈密顿量的基态编码于单一变分波函数中；因拟设显式依赖耦合，目标性质成为耦合的可微函数，逆向设计化为耦合空间中的梯度优化。应用于受阻方格子Heisenberg模型，逐步增加次近邻耦合数目。
AI.result: 单一耦合时复现已知 $J_1$-$J_2$ 非磁窗口；两对角耦合独立变化时揭示连接方格子与各向异性三角格子区的扩展非磁区域；八耦合2×2元胞搜索自发收敛到 $J_1$-$J_2$-$δ$ 模型（对角耦合在相邻格间交替），16×16有限尺寸标度表明基态无磁、二聚或等边三角形序。
AI.conclusion: 该 $J_1$-$J_2$-$δ$ 模型确立为区别于既往方案的新型方格子量子自旋液体候选，展示了神经网络量子态在强关联体系逆向设计中的有效性。

title: Second-order Real Nodal Lines in Nodal Surface Semimetals
summary: Real nodal lines (RNLs) featuring real Chern numbers and second-order boundary modes have attracted widespread attention. In all previously reported realizations, an RNL is linked by another nodal line, and whether an RNL can be linked by other types of band degeneracies has remained open. Here, we propose a second-order real nodal-line semimetal in which a pair of RNLs is linked by a nodal surface. We show that this state can be realized in spinless systems with both $PT$ and nonsymmorphic $S_{2z}T$ symmetries, where the $S_{2z}T$-enforced nodal surface prevents the pair of RNLs from annihilation. Each nodal line carries a nontrivial real Chern number $ν_R=1$, giving rise to topological hinge Fermi arcs located at a pair of $PT$-related hinges. Guided by this construction, we identify the interpenetrated graphene network (IGN) as a promising material realization. First-principles calculations confirm that a pair of nodal lines traversing the Brillouin zone are linked by a nodal surface and each nodal line carries double nontrivial $Z_2$ charges. The bulk-boundary correspondence of IGN manifests as a pair of hinge Fermi arcs together with drumhead surface states. Our work establishes nodal surfaces as a new linking partner for real nodal lines and provides a roadmap for exploring higher-order real topology in carbon-based and other light-element systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由节面连接一对实节线的二阶实节线半金属，可在同时具有PT和S2zT对称性的无自旋系统中实现，并预言互穿石墨烯网络(IGN)为材料候选。
AI.motivation: 实节线(RNL)因具有实陈数和二阶边界模而备受关注，但此前所有实现中RNL均由另一条节线连接，RNL能否被其他类型能带简并连接尚属未知。
AI.method: 在同时具有PT与nonsymmorphic S2zT对称性的无自旋系统中构造模型，利用S2zT强制的节面阻止一对RNL湮灭；结合第一性原理计算验证IGN材料。
AI.result: 每条节线携带非平庸实陈数νR=1，产生位于一对PT相关铰链的拓扑铰链费米弧；IGN中一对穿越布里渊区的节线被节面连接，各携带双重非平庸Z2荷，边界表现为铰链费米弧与鼓面表面态。
AI.conclusion: 本工作确立了节面作为实节线的新型连接伙伴，为在碳基及轻元素体系中探索高阶实拓扑提供了路线图。

title: Phase-Field Modeling of Liquid Phases with Ordering
summary: A strong negative enthalpy of mixing can lead to ordering in liquid solutions. To describe ordering in liquids, different thermodynamic descriptions of liquid phases have been developed in the CALPHAD approach, including the associate model and the modified quasichemical model. In this study, we show that the key to directly incorporate these liquid phase models and their corresponding CALPHAD-type free energy formulations in phase-field simulations, is to identify the internal processes and to properly define the internal thermodynamic variables. The free energy of the liquid phase can then be converted to a function of component compositions and internal variables, and the evolution of the internal variables will be determined via Allen-Cahn-type relaxation equations. We demonstrate this modeling strategy using the formation of stoichiometric phases from liquid phases in Na-Sb and Na-Sn systems. This study will pave the way for predicting microstructure evolution in liquids with ordering using phase-field simulations.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出将CALPHAD液相模型（缔合模型与改进的准化学模型）直接耦合进相场模拟的方法，通过定义内部热力学变量并转化为自由能函数，用Allen-Cahn型弛豫方程描述其演化，并在Na-Sb和Na-Sn体系中演示了液相生成化学计量相的过程。
AI.motivation: 液相中强负混合焓会导致有序化，但CALPHAD框架下的液相有序模型（缔合模型、改进准化学模型）难以直接嵌入相场模拟，缺乏有效的耦合手段。
AI.method: 识别液相内部的物理过程并定义内部热力学变量，将液相自由能表示为成分与内部变量的函数，其演化由Allen-Cahn型弛豫方程描述，从而把CALPHAD型自由能公式直接用于相场模拟。以Na-Sb和Na-Sn体系中液相生成化学计量相为例进行验证。
AI.result: 成功在Na-Sb和Na-Sn体系中模拟了从液相中形成化学计量相的过程，验证了该建模策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该策略为利用相场模拟预测具有有序化的液相微观组织演化开辟了道路。

title: A transferable full-band Monte Carlo framework for complex alloy avalanche photodiodes
summary: We present a physics-based multiscale full-band Monte Carlo framework for modeling avalanche multiplication and excess noise in complex alloy avalanche photodiodes (APDs), demonstrated on Al$_{0.7}$InAsSb as a representative quaternary system. The framework links atomistic material structure to device-level avalanche statistics: an environment-dependent $sp^3d^5s^\ast$ tight-binding calculation resolves the full conduction- and valence-band structure of the random- or digital-alloy configuration -- including $Γ$, X, and L valley ordering, non-parabolicity, anisotropy, and spin-orbit-induced valence-band splitting -- and supplies the band-structure inputs for stochastic high-field transport. A central element of the framework is a physics-derived treatment of alloy-disorder scattering, in which the quaternary disorder potential is constructed from atomic valence differences, covalent radii, and Thomas--Fermi screening through a composition-weighted decomposition into binary contributions, complemented by composition-interpolated polar-optical, acoustic, intervalley-phonon, impurity, and impact-ionization models. Because every material-dependent input is generated from the atomic composition and configuration by the same well-defined procedure, the framework transfers without structural modification to arbitrary zinc-blende ternary and quaternary alloys. Applied to a \SI{1}{\micro\meter} Al$_{0.7}$InAsSb p-i-n APD, the framework reproduces the measured gain and excess-noise characteristics with only the impact-ionization softness parameters calibrated. The approach provides a documented, reproducible route for analyzing and designing complex alloy APDs in which band structure, disorder, and scattering physics jointly determine gain and ionization statistics.

AI.tldr: 提出物理基多尺度全带蒙特卡洛框架，可将原子结构与器件级雪崩统计相连，成功建模Al0.7InAsSb APD的增益与过剩噪声。
AI.motivation: 复杂合金APD中能带结构、合金无序与散射物理共同决定增益和电离统计，缺乏从原子结构到器件统计的统一、可迁移建模方法。
AI.method: 环境依赖sp3d5s*紧束缚计算全带结构（Γ/X/L谷序、非抛物性、各向异性、自旋轨道劈裂）；基于原子价差、共价半径与Thomas-Fermi屏蔽构造成分加权合金无序散射；结合成分插值的极性光学、声学、谷间声子、杂质与碰撞电离模型。
AI.result: 对1微米Al0.7InAsSb p-i-n APD，仅校准碰撞电离软度参数即可复现实测增益与过剩噪声特性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需结构修改即可迁移至任意闪锌矿三元/四元合金，为复杂合金APD的分析与设计提供了可记录、可复现的路径。

title: Phonon-mediated closing of topological Floquet gaps in graphene: Non-phenomenological analysis
summary: Floquet band engineering has been intensively studied for its potential to control material properties via laser driving. In particular, Floquet topological states have been measured on the surface of Bi$_2$Se$_3$. Nonetheless, the original prediction of Floquet topological bands in graphene remains unobserved, with works only measuring non-topological Floquet-Bloch states or indirect features. Here, we theoretically explore graphene irradiated by circular lasers with non-phenomenological electron-phonon (e-ph) coupling. We show that e-ph interactions substantially broaden Floquet bands due to graphene's large zero-point motion, as expected from phenomenological treatments. However, we further find that larger displacement $Γ$ optical phonons reduce Floquet gaps by about half, even in absence of instrumentation broadening, and can also induce additional features like flat bands. These phonons "enter the gap" and blur photoemission signatures. Including non-$Γ$ phonons closes the gap and greatly reduces visibility. When these modes couple to reasonably expected instrumentation broadening, the effect is significantly exacerbated. Our results propose an answer to the missing Floquet topological gaps and also lead to clear mitigation strategies: (i) Pre-pumping coherent phonons to counteract blurring, or (ii), transition to a Dirac system with more favorable phonon statistics. Moreover, our analysis proposes that Floquet topological physics is alive in localized regions, such that properties of interest like transport should be accessible. We expect this work to impact experimental analysis and lead to set-ups where graphene Floquet topology might finally be directly observed.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究非唯象电子-声子耦合下圆偏振激光辐照石墨烯的Floquet能带，解释为何Floquet拓扑能隙在实验上"缺失"，并提出缓解策略。
AI.motivation: Floquet能带工程备受关注，Bi₂Se₃表面已测得Floquet拓扑态，但石墨烯中最初预言的Floquet拓扑能带始终未被观测到，以往工作仅测得非拓扑Floquet-Bloch态或间接信号，亟需理论解释这一"缺失"现象。
AI.method: 采用非唯象电子-声子(e-ph)耦合，理论计算圆偏振激光辐照石墨烯的Floquet能带，考察Γ光学声子与非Γ声子对Floquet能隙的影响，并结合仪器展宽效应分析。
AI.result: e-ph相互作用因石墨烯大零点运动显著展宽Floquet能带；大位移Γ光学声子即使无仪器展宽也将Floquet能隙减小约一半，并诱发平带等额外特征；非Γ声子会闭合能隙并大幅降低可见度；叠加仪器展宽后效应显著加剧。
AI.conclusion: 结果解释了Floquet拓扑能隙缺失的原因，并给出缓解策略：(i)预抽运相干声子抵消模糊，(ii)转向声子统计更优的狄拉克体系。Floquet拓扑物理在局域区域仍存在，输运等性质应可探测，有望推动石墨烯Floquet拓扑的最终直接观测。

title: Engineering Grain Boundary Commensurability for Ferroelectric Stabilization in Hafnia-Based Films
summary: Grain boundaries fundamentally dictate the macroscopic properties of polycrystalline materials by breaking long-range symmetry. In ferroelectrics, these structural discontinuities are conventionally considered as detrimental features that induce depolarization fields and accumulate defects, thereby suppressing or pinning local polarization. Here, we demonstrate that the commensurability of grain boundaries inherently governs the polar-orthorhombic phase stability in polycrystalline Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) thin films. Using depth-resolved multislice electron ptychography, we map the three-dimensional (3D) phase distribution across diverse boundaries with atomic resolution, revealing that highly commensurate grain boundaries effectively suppress the nonpolar-tetragonal phase by compensating for lattice mismatch while mitigating geometric frustration. Monte Carlo simulations uncover the atomistic and energetic origins of polar-phase stabilization, showing that commensurate grain boundaries favor the polar-orthorhombic phase more strongly than other grain boundaries. Guided by this principle, we epitaxially engineer HZO thin films to promote the preferential formation of commensurate grain boundaries, resulting in an approximately 60% enhancement in the remanent polarization of ferroelectric devices. These findings provide direct 3D experimental and theoretical evidence that establishes grain boundary commensurability as a critical degree of freedom for designing functional interfaces, guiding the construction of novel ceramics and polycrystalline ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 晶界共格性调控多晶HZO薄膜铁电极性正交相稳定性，外延工程提升剩余极化约60%。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为铁电材料中的晶界是有害缺陷，会引发退极化场和缺陷积累，抑制或钉扎局域极化。本文旨在探究晶界结构（共格性）是否反而能调控极性相稳定性。
AI.method: 采用深度分辨多层电子叠层成像（multislice electron ptychography）以原子分辨率三维映射不同晶界的相分布；结合Monte Carlo模拟揭示极性相稳定的原子与能量起源；并据此外延工程化HZO薄膜以促进共格晶界形成。
AI.result: 高共格晶界通过补偿晶格失配、缓解几何阻挫，有效抑制非极性四方相；共格晶界比其他晶界更强地偏好极性正交相；外延工程使铁电器件剩余极化提升约60%。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了直接的三维实验与理论证据，确立晶界共格性作为功能界面设计的关键自由度，为新型陶瓷和多晶铁电材料的设计提供指导。

title: Cluster-based Structural Similarity for Dataset Visualization and Data Selection for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are essential components for accelerating simulation-driven materials design. Data-efficient MLIP training relies on data-selection strategies that maximize structural diversity while limiting computationally expensive first-principles calculations. A key challenge in such strategies is evaluating structural similarity, which involves a trade-off between retaining information on individual atomic environments and reducing computational cost. Here, we propose similarity evaluation methods that achieve both representational fidelity and computational efficiency. Our method represents each structure using a small set of characteristic atomic environments identified by k-medoids clustering and computes pairwise similarity through optimal matching between these representatives or their distributions. Molecular benchmarks demonstrate that our method is approximately 50 times faster than the baseline method while also more clearly distinguishing structures with different chemical compositions. Similarity-based data-selection benchmarks demonstrate that our methods improve the data efficiency and stability of force prediction in MLIPs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于k-medoids代表性原子环境的结构相似度评估方法，兼顾表征保真度与计算效率，用于MLIP的数据选择。
AI.motivation: 数据高效的MLIP训练依赖数据选择策略，而结构相似度评估面临保留原子环境信息与降低计算成本之间的权衡。
AI.method: 用k-medoids聚类选出少量特征原子环境代表结构，通过对代表点或其分布进行最优匹配计算成对相似度。
AI.result: 分子基准上比基线方法快约50倍，且能更清晰区分不同化学组成的结构；基于相似度的数据选择提升了MLIP力预测的数据效率与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法同时实现表征保真与计算高效，有效改进MLIP的数据选择。

title: Training and memory in a randomly driven fractal gel
summary: A variety of disordered materials, including jammed particulate systems and crumpled paper, can be trained to exhibit memory of a cyclic strain amplitude. Only recently, however, have questions emerged around the whether random driving can impart similar training. Here, we employ x-ray photon correlation spectroscopy to study a fractal nanoparticle gel trained via either deterministic cyclic shear or random shear bounded by strain amplitudes $-γ_t$ and $+γ_t$. Both types of training lead to microstructural reversibility, with a slower and more irregular training for the random protocol. In both cases, the shear induces redistribution of internal stress in the gel with corresponding irreversible strain displacements whose magnitudes decrease during training. Finally, we show that memory of the random driving can be read out and quantified using a standard protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文利用X射线光子相关光谱研究分形纳米颗粒凝胶，发现确定性与随机剪切训练均能导致微观结构可逆性，且可用标准协议读出并量化随机驱动记忆。
AI.motivation: 无序材料（如堵塞颗粒系统、褶皱纸）可被训练以记住循环应变振幅，但随机驱动能否赋予类似训练记忆尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用X射线光子相关光谱（XPCS），对分别经确定性循环剪切和受限于应变振幅±γt的随机剪切训练的分形纳米颗粒凝胶进行观测。
AI.result: 两种训练均导致微观结构可逆性；随机协议训练更慢且更不规则。剪切诱导凝胶内部应力重分布并伴随不可逆应变位移，其幅度在训练中减小。随机驱动记忆可被读出并量化。
AI.conclusion: 随机驱动也能赋予无序材料记忆，且该记忆可通过标准协议读出和量化，拓展了材料训练记忆的适用范围。

title: A latent-space extrapolation grade built into graph atomic cluster expansion foundation potentials
comment: 48 pages, 8 figures and 1 table in the main text; supplementary information with 12 figures and 8 tables
summary: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials cover broad configurational and chemical spaces, but their reliability can vary across the atomic environments encountered during a simulation. Here we introduce the calibrated Mahalanobis (CALM) extrapolation grade $γ$, a piecewise differentiable per-atom quantity integrated into GRACE foundation models and evaluated alongside energies and forces in a single model pass. We define $γ$ from nearest-cluster Mahalanobis distances in latent feature space, setting $γ=1$ from the training-distance distribution separately for each element and cluster. Controlled tests show that a normalized random projection of the invariant many-body basis detects structural and chemical extrapolation. On different foundation datasets, OMat24 and SMAX, $γ$ correlates with atomic force errors and separates structures with different error distributions. The CALM grade adds percent-level computational cost, and its spatial gradient guides uncertainty-biased data collection toward configurations with larger absolute force errors.

AI.tldr: 提出CALM外推等级γ，作为逐原子可微指标集成进GRACE基础模型，用于检测原子环境的外推不确定性，成本仅增加百分之几。
AI.motivation: 基础机器学习原子间势虽覆盖广泛构型与化学空间，但其在模拟中遇到的具体原子环境上的可靠性可能不稳定，需要可评估外推程度的不确定性指标。
AI.method: 定义基于潜在特征空间中最近簇马氏距离的γ，按元素与簇分别由训练距离分布设γ=1；采用不变多体基的归一化随机投影进行检测；γ可在单次模型前向中与能量、力一起计算，并分段可微。
AI.result: 在OMat24与SMAX数据集上，γ与原子力误差相关，并能区分不同误差分布的构型；仅增加百分之几的计算成本；其空间梯度可引导偏向不确定性的数据采集，趋向绝对力误差更大的构型。
AI.conclusion: CALM外推等级是一种低成本、可微的逐原子外推度量，能有效关联力误差并指导主动学习式数据采集，提升基础势模型的可靠性评估。

title: Controlling Switching Evolution in Lead-Free Perovskite-Inspired Chalcogenide Memristors for Neuromorphic Computing
summary: Memristors have emerged as key building blocks of neuromorphic computing architectures due to their ability to integrate data storage and processing. While metal halide perovskites have recently shown significant promise owing to their mixed electronic-ionic conduction and low-cost solution processability, their reliance on toxic lead and limited stability presents critical challenges. Here, we report environmentally friendly, low-toxicity AgBiS2-based solution-processable memristors exhibiting an ultra-low SET voltage of ~0.08 V and a high ON/OFF ratio of >104. First-principles calculations identify Ag interstitials as the energetically most favourable native defect and reveal low migration barriers within the Ag sublattice, for both interstitials and vacancies, facilitating ionic transport in the AgBiS2 lattice. Through interface and thickness engineering, the resistive switching behaviour can be systematically tuned from abrupt digital to gradual analog modes. Notably, thicker switching layers promote the evolution of stable conductive pathways through intermediate metastable states, revealing a controllable filament evolution process. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy reveals pronounced negative capacitance (inductive) behaviour at low bias voltages, arising from coupled electronic-ionic dynamics. Consistent with this behaviour, pulse measurements demonstrate gradual conductance modulation under pulse trains, emulating synaptic responses relevant for neuromorphic computing. Finally, post-operando structural analysis reveals substantial morphological evolution of the switching layer driven by repeated filament formation and rupture. Linking structural dynamics to switching variability provides important design principles for achieving reliable and durable sustainable memristors.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了环保低毒的AgBiS2溶液工艺忆阻器，SET电压低至~0.08 V、ON/OFF比>10⁴，通过界面与厚度工程实现数字/模拟阻变调控，并揭示其离子迁移与突触响应机制。
AI.motivation: 金属卤化物钙钛矿忆阻器虽具混合电子-离子导电与低成本溶液加工优势，但含毒铅且稳定性差；需开发环保、低毒且性能优异的替代材料。
AI.method: 采用溶液工艺制备AgBiS2忆阻器；通过第一性原理计算分析本征缺陷与迁移势垒；利用界面与厚度工程调控阻变模式；结合电化学阻抗谱、脉冲测量及操作后结构分析研究开关机制。
AI.result: AgBiS2忆阻器实现~0.08 V超低SET电压与>10⁴高ON/OFF比；Ag间隙为最有利本征缺陷，Ag亚晶格中间隙/空位迁移势垒低；厚度增大促进经由亚稳态的稳定导电通路演化；低偏压下出现负电容（电感）行为；脉冲下电导渐进调制，模拟突触响应。
AI.conclusion: 研究将结构动态与开关变异性关联，为设计可靠、耐用且可持续的忆阻器提供了重要设计原则。
